newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Zim Navigation swings into Qi net loss.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Zim Navigation swings into Qi net loss.

text.p: Israel's Zim Israel Navigation Ltd swung into a first quarter net loss of $12.8 million after a $2.1 million profit in the same last-year period.
The company, a subsidiary of the Israel Corp, attributed the loss to the continuing decline of freight rates.

"The fierce competition continues in all of the company trade areas. It derives mainly from the introduction of new vessels to the market and of large shipping companies entering trade areas in which they did not operate before," the company said in a statement.
"In order to successfully overcome the above negative effects on the financial results, the company continues taking steps to increase income and reduce expenses," the statement said.

Zim said the number of containers it carried in the quarter declined 3.7 percent from a year ago to 213,700 TEU. However, the number of cars carried increased 63 percent and the quanitty of bulk cargo by 183 percent.
Zim is 51 percent controlled by the Israel Corp, with the remainder owned by the Israeli government.
